title: Montserrat and salt mine
text: Marcel was an excellent guide. He picked my mother and I up from near our hotel and shared tons of information throughout the day. We had booked a group tour but ended up with a private one which was nice. The time in Montserrat was well balanced with both guided and free time. We then headed to the salt mine which was beautiful and interesting. If you speak English bring headphones for the audio guide you can listen to on your phone. title: Rainy Day in Spain

author: brentsB4823ZH

title: Spectacular
text: Excellent excursion to Montserrat, Cardona, and the Salt Mines. Our guide, Albert, was spectacular: very knowledgeable, kind, and passionate about the history and culture of Catalonia. In addition to the explanations, he gave us excellent local recommendations that made the experience even more special. Everything was very well organized and it was a fantastic way to see some of the most impressive places in Catalonia. Highly recommended!
author: Adventure02422906947

title: Private Tour is Better
text: Marcel was our driver and tour guide. He was polite, on-time, very kind and accommodating. He explained the sites history and gave us free time. Safe and smooth driver. Vehicle was spacious and air conditioning was good for summer.
author: 29elyt

title: Get out of town
text: Picked up at hotel and had beautiful drive to Cardona, a beautiful castle with attached hotel and restaurant. Next visited salt mine. Fascinating. Had a delicious lunch in nearby village. Then on to Monserrat . Spectacular views and interesting history. Our driver and guide, David, was a fountain of information and catered to our every need.
author: W6210UPthomasb

title: Excellent day trip
text: We had a fantastic day. Our guide, David, was excellent company and very knowledgeable. So many highlights, but seeing the annual Easter festivities in Cardona was very special. We highly recommend this trip and David as a guide.
author: clivebX5749JN

title: A rich day in Catalunya
text: It was an awesome day with our guide Ramón into the countryside of Spain. He is an amazing person and told us about the history behind each stop on our trip. Very energetic and sympathetic guide! If you like to get in touch with real local history, this is the tour for you. We started the tour going to Montserrat, roughly 1 hour on the road to get there. It is a beautiful place with astonishing views and architecture. It is one of the most important foundational places for Barcelona and Spain. Then we went to the salt mines.
